Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:10:1.hebrew: דכמאן דפסיק דמי - וקנייה מקנה, והמכר נקנה בו ללוקח. ודוקא נקט שלש על שלש, דכלי בעינן, דכתיב (רות ד) נעלו, ובציר משלש אצבעות לאו בגד הוא, כדאשכחן גבי טומאה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:10:1.english: Because it is considered as though it were severed - And the transferor acquires it, and the sold item is acquired through it by the buyer. And it specifically stated three by three [fingerbreadths], for we require a utensil, as it is written (Ruth 4): "His shoe," and less than three fingerbreadths is not a garment, as we find with regard to ritual impurity.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:11:1.english: A bill of divorce in her hand - That he gave it to her.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:1:1.english: Rather, what have you to say - Why did they not obligate him to tithe, whichever way you look at it?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:1:2.hebrew: עשירי ודאי - הצריך הכתוב לעשר, ולא הצריך לעשר את הספק. וכל עשירי שבכאן ספק הן, שאפילו יצא הפטור בחמישי, שוב אין העשירי קרוי עשירי אלא תשיעי, שהפטור אינו מן המנין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:1:2.english: A definite tenth - Scripture required [one] to tithe [a definite tenth], and did not require [one] to tithe an uncertain [tenth]. And all the tenths here are of uncertain status, for even if the exempt [animal] came out fifth, the tenth [animal] is no longer called "tenth," but rather "ninth," as the exempt [animal] is not included in the count.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:2:1.hebrew: מאי ספיקות - דאמרן לעיל, הספיקות נכנסין לדיר להתעשר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:2:1.english: What are [these] uncertain [animals] - [That] which we said above: "The uncertain [animals] enter the pen to be tithed."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:3:1.hebrew: ספק פדיון פטר חמור - טלה שהופרש על ספק פטר חמור, שאפילו הוא פטר חמור ודאי, אין בטלה זה של פדיון משום קדושה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:3:1.english: An uncertain redemption of a firstborn donkey - A lamb that was designated for an uncertain firstborn donkey, for even if it were a definite firstborn donkey, there is no sanctity in this redemption lamb.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:3:2.hebrew: עשרה שיין - לאפקועי איסורייהו, למשרי להו בעבודה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:3:2.english: Ten lambs - To remove their prohibition, [and] to permit them for work.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:4:1.hebrew: עובדא הוה בי רב חסדא ורב חסדא בי רב הונא - מעשה היה ובא לפני רב חסדא, ורב חסדא הביאו לפני רב הונא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:4:1.english: There was an incident in the house of Rav Ḥisda, and Rav Ḥisda [in] the house of Rav Huna - An incident occurred and came before Rav Ḥisda, and Rav Ḥisda brought it before Rav Huna.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:4:2.hebrew: שאינה יכול להוציאו כו' - והאי נמי דחזינן ליה דאין יכול להוציאו בדיינין, שאין לו ראיה בדבר, אין הקדישו קדוש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:4:2.english: That [one] cannot recover it, etc. - And in this [case] as well, since we see that he cannot recover it through judges, as he has no proof in the matter, his consecration is not sacred.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:5:1.english: Behold, [if] he can recover it, etc. - [This is asked] in astonishment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:5:2.english: Because it is not in his possession - And surely an ordinary case of robbery is [one where] one can recover it through the judges.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:6:1.english: In [the case of] a movable bathhouse - Such as a tub.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:6:2.hebrew: מקרקעי - דכל היכא דאיתיה, ברשות מרי' קיימא, דקרקע אינה נגזלת. ושפיר פשיטנא מהא, דאי הוה ליה ראיה עלה, הקדישו הקדש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:6:2.english: Immovable property - For wherever it is, it stands in the possession of its owner, as land cannot be stolen. And we correctly resolved [the matter] from this, that if he had proof for it, his consecration is valid.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:7:1.english: A man of the West - From the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:7:2.english: He indicated to him - [He was] pointing with his fingers upward.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:8:1.english: By the fringes - By the fringes at the two ends [of the garment], which they call barneis [fringes].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:9:1.hebrew: ש"מ - מדקתני: עד מקום שידו מגעת, קנוי לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:9:1.english: Learn from this - From [the fact] that it teaches: Up to the place where his hand reaches is acquired by him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:9:2.hebrew: האי סודרא - של קונה, שקונין בו קנין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:9:2.english: This scarf - [Belongs to] the buyer, with which they effect an acquisition.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:9:3.hebrew: כיון דתפיס ביה - מקנה שלש על שלש, קרינא ביה ושלף איש נעלו ונתן לרעהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 7a:9:3.english: Once he grasps it - [Once] the transferor [grasps] three by three [fingerbreadths], we read concerning it: "A man drew off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbor."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 7a:1:1.hebrew: ולא עשירי ספק - אין להקשות: איצטריך קרא למעוטי ספיקא, כדפריך במסכת חולין (דף כב: ד"ה איצטריך):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 7a:1:1.english: And not an uncertain tenth - One should not ask: "Was a verse necessary to exclude an uncertainty?" as [Tosafot] asks in Tractate Chullin (22b, s.v. Itztarikh).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 7a:3:1.hebrew: מפריש עליהן עשרה שיין - תימה, דבפ"ק דבכורות (דף יא. ושם) אמרי' דשה אחד פוטר כמה פטרי חמורים, ומה צריך עשרה שיים? ותו, מאי קא משמע לן? מתני' היא: הספיקות נכנסים לדיר להתעשר! ותו, כיון דאמר מעשרן, מה צריך להשמיענו דהן שלו? פשיטא, כיון דמעשרן דהן שלו, דאילו היו של כהן לא היה מעשרן, דהוו להו כלקוח, דתנן (שם דף נה:): הלקוח והניתן לו במתנה פטור. ואי קמ"ל דאע"ג דמעשרן עדיין הם שלו, פשיטא דמעשר בהמה של בעלים הוא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 7a:3:1.english: He separates ten lambs for them - This is puzzling: For in the first chapter of Bekhorot (11a, and see there), we say that one lamb exempts several [uncertain] firstborn donkeys; why, then, does he need ten lambs? And furthermore, what does this come to teach us? It is a mishna [Bekhorot 53b]: "Animals of uncertain status enter the pen to be tithed!" And furthermore, since he says "and he tithes them," why does he need to inform us that "they are his"? It is obvious that since he tithes them, they are his; for if they belonged to the priest, he could not tithe them, as they would have the status of [an animal that was] purchased, as we learned in a mishna (ibid. 55b): "An animal that was purchased or given to him as a gift is exempt [from animal tithe]." And if [one suggests that] it comes to teach us that even though he tithes them, they are still his — it is obvious that animal tithe belongs to the owner!

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 7a:7:1.hebrew: מחוי ר' אבהו והשאר בשבועה - נראה דלא גרסי' והשאר, דאף במה שידו מגעת ישבע; כיון דנתקנה השבועה שלא יהא אדם הולך ותוקף, מטעם זה ישבע אף במה שהוא תופס. ומכל מקום, שפיר מוכח בסמוך דבקנין מאי דתפיס כמאן דפסיק דמי, כיון דהכא לאחר שבועה נוטל כל מה שהוא תופס, אפילו יותר ממחצה; והשבועה היא בשביל הטענה ומפני התקנה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 7a:7:1.english: Rabbi Abbahu indicated: And the remainder is with an oath - It seems that we should not read "and the remainder," for he must swear even regarding that which his hand reaches; since the oath was instituted so that a person should not go and seize [another's garment], for this reason he must swear even regarding that which he is holding. And nevertheless, it is well proven immediately below that regarding an act of acquisition, that which one holds is considered as though it were severed, since here, following the oath, he takes all that he is holding, even if it is more than half; and the oath is [only] on account of the claim and because of the [rabbinic] enactment.
